description: This Dart source file defines UI screens for a quiz feature in a Flutter app, including the list of quizzes, quiz detail, and quiz result screens. It imports external repositories and widgets, manages state, and handles navigation between quiz-related views.

classes.name: QuizListScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays a list of available quizzes as cards, allowing users to navigate to quiz details.

classes.name: QuizDetailScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that runs a specific quiz identified by quizId, showing questions and options, and handling quiz completion.

classes.name: QuizResultScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the final score after completing a quiz, with an option to finish.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, sets up quiz progress store and current state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the respective screen.

methods.name: onPressed
methods.description: Handles button presses for starting quizzes and selecting answers.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a quiz is finished to update stored results.
